description: The Campveerse Toren is the harbour defence tower at Veere. It is round toward the water and flat toward the town, with a stepped gable and pinnacles, and the walls are red brick banded with white stone. Later wings sit beside it. It is overcast, about 13.4°C, with wind near 9.4 km/h and cloud cover about 99%. No restaurant name is shown.
